#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
using pii = pair<int, int>;
using pll = pair<ll, ll>;
using vi = vector<int>;
using vll = vector<ll>;

template<typename T> using triple = struct { T a, b, c; bool operator<(const triple& o) const { if (a != o.a) return a < o.a; if (b != o.b) return b < o.b; return c < o.c; } };

template<typename T> ostream& operator<<(ostream& out, const pair<T,T>& p) { return out << "(" << p.first << ", " << p.second << ")"; }
template<typename A, typename B, typename C> ostream& operator<<(ostream& out, const triple<A,B,C>& t) { return out << "(" << t.a << ", " << t.b << ", " << t.c << ")"; }
template<typename T> ostream& operator<<(ostream& out, const vector<T>& v) { out << "("; for (const auto& x : v) out << x << ", "; return out << ")"; }

ll MOD;
ll mod_pow(ll base, ll exp) {
  ll res = 1;
  while (exp) {
    if (exp & 1) res = res * base % MOD;
    base = base * base % MOD;
    exp >>= 1;
  }
  return res;
}
ll mod_inv(ll a) { return mod_pow(a, MOD - 2); }

ll f_func(ll c, ll p) {
  if (p == 0) return 1;
  return mod_pow(c + 1, p - 1) * ((c + 1 - p) % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
}

const int MAX_N = 515;
ll C[MAX_N][MAX_N], invC[MAX_N][MAX_N];

int main() {
  ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
  cin.tie(nullptr);
  
  ll c, p;
  cin >> c >> p >> MOD;
  
  for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; ++i) {
    C[i][0] = C[i][i] = 1;
    for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j)
      C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j] + C[i-1][j-1]) % MOD;
  }
  
  for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; ++i)
    for (int j = 0; j <= c + 1; ++j)
      invC[i][j] = mod_inv(C[i][j]);
  
  ll ans = f_func(c, p);
  ans = ans * mod_pow(2, p) % MOD;
  
  ll sum_e = 0;
  for (int i = 1; i <= p; ++i) {
    ll e = 0;
    for (int w = 1; w <= i - 1; ++w) {
      ll term = C[i-1][w] * f_func(w, w) % MOD * f_func(c - w - 1, i - 1 - w) % MOD;
      term = term * mod_inv(mod_pow(c + 1, i - 1)) % MOD;
      e = (e + 1LL * w * (w + 1) / 2 * term) % MOD;
    }
    sum_e = (sum_e + e) % MOD;
  }
  
  cout << ans * sum_e % MOD << "\n";
  return 0;
}
